# Fairy Frills

> Fairy Frills is an Indian designer clothing brand specialising in handcrafted baby girl dresses and mother-daughter matching outfits for life's most special moments.

## About

Fairy Frills creates premium, handcrafted children's and women's clothing with a focus on intricate detailing, soft fabrics, and occasion wear. Every piece is designed in India for Indian celebrations — birthdays, festivals, weddings, and everyday magic.

- Brand: Fairy Frills
- Country: India
- Currency: INR (Indian Rupee)
- Language: English, Hindi
- Founded: India
- Contact: Available via the contact page

## Products

Fairy Frills sells the following product categories:

- **Birthday Outfits** — Princess dresses, tutu gowns, and party wear for baby girls
- **Mother Daughter Combos** — Matching twinning sets for mothers and daughters for festivals, photoshoots, and special occasions
- **Seasonal Collection** — Light summer dresses and season-specific styles for baby girls
- **Theme Dresses** — Dresses built around specific themes for events and celebrations

All products are handcrafted and available in sizes from newborn (0–3 months) up to 8 years for children, and standard adult sizes for mothers.

## Features

- Virtual Try-On powered by AI — customers can upload a photo and see how dresses look on their child
- Customisation available — colour, embellishments, and sizing on request
- Pan-India delivery (5–7 business days standard)
- Razorpay payment integration (UPI, cards, net banking)
- OTP-based login (email and phone) — no password required

## Shipping & Returns

- Standard delivery: 5–7 business days across India
- Express shipping available at checkout
- Returns accepted within 7 days of delivery for unused items in original packaging
- Customised orders are non-returnable unless defective

## Customer Support

- Available in English and Hindi
- Contact via the website contact form at https://fairyfrills.in/in/contact
- Support for orders, customisations, sizing, and general queries
